## Load packages

```{r init}
require("RPostgres", quietly = TRUE)
require("sqldf", quietly = TRUE)
library("sp", quietly = TRUE)
library("rgdal", quietly = TRUE)
library("sf", quietly = TRUE)
library("tmap", quietly=TRUE)
library(hydroloom) # working with river networks(bifurcations etc.)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}

# Connect to EDA database
EDA_con <- dbConnect(drv = Postgres(), 
                     dbname = "eda2.4",
                     user="postgres",
                     password="postgres")
```

## Find distinct basins in river network
```{sql, connection="EDA_con", output.var = "basins"}
#| engine: knitr
SELECT DISTINCT maincatchment 
FROM
alt_insp.watercourselink
WHERE NOT isinsea;

```

## Find nextdownidsegment, divergence and isinlandoutlet
```{r}

# create hydroloom names
hnames <- c(gml_id="id",length="lengthm") # hydroloom need to define names for ids etc.
hydroloom_names(hnames,clear=FALSE)

# remove basins far upstream
basins <- basins$maincatchment[!basins$maincatchment %in% c(114000,116000)]

# IMPORTANT!!! remove table div from database before running loop! 
dbRemoveTable(EDA_con, "div")

for (i in 1:length(basins)) {

print(i)
    
# Extract data from one basin (from database)  
sql_chunk <- paste("SELECT * FROM alt_insp.watercourselink w WHERE NOT isinsea AND maincatchment=",basins[i])
rn <- dbGetQuery(EDA_con,sql_chunk)

# Create an sf-object(spatial feature object)
rn_sf <- rn %>% mutate(geom=st_as_sfc(wkb_geometry))
rn_sf <- st_as_sf(rn_sf)

# make hydroloom object
rn_hy <- hy(rn_sf)

# make a flow net based on spatial information
flow_net <- rn_hy |>
  make_attribute_topology(min_distance = 5) |> # maximum distance between end and startnodes
  make_node_topology(add_div = TRUE) |>
  left_join(rn_hy, by = "id")


if (basins[i] == 301000){

dendr_netw <- flow_net |> 
add_toids(return_dendritic = FALSE)# no divergences in this basin therefore just add toids

# Write to postgres temporary table
dbWriteTable(EDA_con, "div", 
             data.frame(gml_id=dendr_netw$id, 
                        nextdowngml_id=dendr_netw$toid,
                        divergence=0, # no divergences in this basin
                        isinlandoutlet= 
                        (!dendr_netw$endnode %in% dendr_netw$startnode) & !dendr_netw$issea), append=TRUE)

}else{

# Find divergences(bifurcations)
dendr_netw <- add_divergence(flow_net, 
               coastal_outlet_ids = flow_net$id[flow_net$issea], 
               inland_outlet_ids = flow_net$id[(!flow_net$endnode %in% flow_net$startnode) & !flow_net$issea], 
               name_attr = "fk_gml_id_wcls", 
               type_attr = "fictitious", 
               major_types = unique(flow_net$fictitious)) |>
  add_toids(return_dendritic = TRUE) 

# Write to temporary postgres table
dbWriteTable(EDA_con, "div", data.frame(gml_id=dendr_netw$id, 
                                        nextdowngml_id=dendr_netw$toid,
                                        divergence=dendr_netw$divergence,
                                        isinlandoutlet= (!dendr_netw$endnode %in% dendr_netw$startnode) & !dendr_netw$issea),
             append=TRUE)
}
}
```
